findings.venue: Sharonville Community Center & Family Aquatic Center
findings.status: partial physical-detail gaps; new listing is supported
findings.findings: Current April 2026 policy is published and parsed: staff demonstrate equipment but do not lift people. Maps on pages 15–16 label levels, entrance areas and elevators but are diagrams, not photographs or current operation evidence. The indexed 2023 report returned fresh 404 on both www and bare hosts, so no historical-elevator or entrance-completion note/guide imported. Gower/Upper Grove renderings are proposals. Lift model, capacity, assistance, exact door/parking connections, toilets and changing remain gaps. Guest ID ages differ between current guide and pool rules.
